patronOf.en-US: Foundress of the Servants of Jesus

prayerExcerpt.en-US: "I want to be a saint, like St. Paul: it is no longer I who live, but Christ who lives in me."
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: "Quero ser santa, como São Paulo: já não sou eu que vivo, é Cristo que vive em mim."

meta.face: A Caraqueña of about sixty with a warm, light-olive complexion and a LONG face with HIGH, prominent cheekbones — dark hair PARTED in the middle and drawn smoothly back under the white veil, a LONG, straight nose with a slight rise at the bridge, dark, bright almond eyes under dark, ARCHED brows, cheeks that fold into long smile creases, a WIDE mouth with a broad, warm, closed-lipped smile, a softly pointed chin; the gaze toward us, affectionate and bright.
meta.basis: Her photographs as superior and in later life (the Dicastery's portrait; the congregation's portrait on madrecarmendevenezuela.com): a long face with high cheekbones, centre-parted dark hair under a white veil, a long straight nose, arched brows and a wide, warm smile, in a grey-blue habit with a wide white collar. Wikipedia and Vatican News record that she was born without her left arm; the card shows only her right hand, without drawing attention to it.
meta.excerpt: Her often-repeated words «quiero ser santa, como San Pablo: no vivo más yo, sino que es Cristo que vive en mí», as quoted by Cardinal Amato (Vatican News, June 2018; Italian in the Dicastery's page); a short quotation, our rendering (she died in 1977)
